'''Sebaddon''' was a small [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Sebaddon was in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic plane]] which made it a part of the thick disk.<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Located near a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]], Sebaddon was scarred by tectonic activity, and the surface of the planet ranged in [[Color/Legends|colors]] from gray to red from the basalt and mantle, respectively. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was dense and showed signs of clouds and precipitation. Sebaddon was covered mostly in [[Magma/Legends|lava]], containing no [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] or large bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]].

==History==
Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Lema Xandret]] went into hiding on Sebaddon after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] took her daughter, [[Eldon Ax|Cinzia]], from her to begin [[Sith training]]. On Sebaddon, Xandret [[Cinzia Xandret|cloned her daughter]] and created [[Fastbreeder|hexes]], a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droid]] that was able to manufacture itself with great expediency, programming the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to protect Cinzia at all costs.

When the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] discovered the planet and found that the hexes would be able to take over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at their rate of growth, they allied for a joint [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|attempt to destroy]] the droids. The mission succeeded when the clone of Cinzia [[Death/Legends|died]], leaving the droids without any purpose. The original Cinzia&mdash;now [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] Eldon Ax&mdash;took control of the droids and ordered them to kill [[Darth Chratis]] before allowing them to destroy themselves. Afterward, the Republic attempted to retrieve some of Sebaddon's rare metals, but due to attacks by the Imperials, their success was limited. The [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Sebaddon was later noted to have been knocked off-course, causing it to begin to spiral down toward the black hole.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]], Sebbadon was classified as part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618822|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:56 PM|quote=Yes, Oktos Sector is named for the nebula.}}</ref>
